items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and do not authorize new spend, deployments, monetization changes, experiments, or requeues. Amazon reported $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but it is aggregate and unattributed; site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and forecasts are unsupported. AI spend is $916.91 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28, while infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, commitments, and budget ceilings are not provided. SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating indicators, not financial outcomes. Continue only the existing matching-period reconciliation, preserving missing values as unknown. Minimum measurement for contribution margin and cost-to-learn: site/content revenue identifiers, a complete matching-period cost ledger, budget ceilings and commitments, and an explicit learning threshold.

Retain the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Reconcile the 18 mapped tracking rows against matching-period recorded costs and preserve the aggregate provider row as unattributed. Do not treat absent infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, commitment, or budget data as zero. The minimum finance artifact is a dated reconciliation showing provider identifiers, site/content revenue, AI and infrastructure costs, other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and the approved cost-to-learn threshold.
